notes.text: Message composer could crash when rotating the screen or editing a message as new
HTML signature text could disappear after rotating the screen
Deleted email notifications could reappear or remain in the notification shade
Some HTML drafts hid attachments while editing and could permanently lose them on save
Add to contacts crashed the app when no Contacts app was installed
Sending large PGP-encrypted attachments showed no progress during encryption
Account drawer behaved inconsistently when reselecting an account or tapping its icon
Account drawer controls blocked accounts and folders on small displays
Sort menu indicator (bullet point) was duplicated each time the menu was opened
